summary: A release-pinned core reads a knowledge manifest authored after its release: at a known schema_version the Go manifest reader drops a field its model does not declare across the root, record, authority, scopes, law relation, criterion binding, domain, architecture relation, and disposition decoders, while an unknown schema_version, duplicate keys, trailing values, and every semantic check still refuse, authoring stays closed behind the unchanged JSON Schema and knowledge-index checker, a field that must restrict older cores needs a schema_version bump, and the committed shard tree may carry no field the Go model drops.
title: The manifest reader admits additive fields
